data.name: Wachira
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Kenyan Bantu language, Wachira means 'God's protection'. This name was traditionally given to babies born during times of war or strife, as a reminder of God's watchful care.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying God's protection in your heart

The name instills a sense of security and resilience, nurturing a spiritual consciousness that imparts peace, strength, and a deeper faith in God throughout one's life.
